+    scores = result.get("category_scores") or {}
+    unsafe = bool(result.get("flagged"))

+        unsafe=unsafe,
+        categories={str(k): bool(v) for k, v in categories.items()},
+        category_scores={str(k): float(v) for k, v in scores.items()},
